hero.title: Busy is not
hero.lede: Practical consulting for owners of businesses with five to fifty people: cash, hiring and the next step. Scroll through a six-month engagement, start to finish.

stages.c: A day in your business: the numbers, the people and the parts you do because nobody else can.
One target for the year and the three milestones that prove you're on track.
Ninety-day sprints, each with one owner and one number to move.
A working session every other week, and a dashboard you check every Monday.
Somewhere around month three, cash gets tight or a hire goes wrong. We plan for it.
Revenue doubled, a manager in place, and a business that runs a week without you.
